senses.gloss: a. Coming from an insect or worm.

N. of a demon killed by Viṣṇu. [He was a very powerful demon. He and Madhu are said to have sprung from the ears of Viṣṇu while he was asleep; and when they were about to devour Brahman they were slain by Viṣṇu]. 
-भा, -भी An epithet of Durgā. 
-Comp. 
-अरिः, -अर्दनः, -जित् m., 
-रिपुः, -हन् epithets of Viṣṇu; एष मानवि ते गर्भं प्रविष्टः कैटभार्दनः [[Bhāg. 3. 24. 18]]; उदमज्जि कैटभजितः शयनात् [[Śi. 9. 30.]]
N. of a medicinal plant (Mar. घाणेरा करंज, कढीलिंब, गेळा).
